_note: PROJECT DEFAULTS for the GEO-MN demonstration. These values are configurable design choices, not mining-industry standards.

study_area.name: Central India manganese belt (Balaghat - Nagpur - Bhandara)

positive_labels.source: USGS Mineral Resources Data System (MRDS), commodity code MN

applicability.method: IsolationForest on the training feature space, score thresholds from training-set quantiles

development_readiness.proxy: distance to nearest documented producing / past-producing Mn site (MRDS) as a proxy for existing access and infrastructure
development_readiness._note: Context only: distance to a documented producer is shown as information and is NOT part of the priority score (no defensible development data).

subsurface_fusion._note: PROJECT-CONFIGURED rules: how a target's evidence maturity, uncertainty and investigation priority WOULD change for each possible outcome of the next investigation. Hypothetical outcomes only: no borehole, assay or geophysical record is generated, and no reserve or tonnage is ever derived. Not an industry standard.

POSITIVE_DRILLING_INTERSECTION.next: Infill / step-out drilling with NABL-accredited assays to progress towards G2 (MEMC Rules 2015); still no reserve until a resource estimate exists.

NEGATIVE_DRILLING_RESULT.next: De-prioritise; review the geological model and structural interpretation before any further drilling.

AMBIGUOUS_DRILLING_RESULT.next: Assay core, log gondite vs oxide ore, and drill step-out holes along strike.

POSITIVE_GEOPHYSICAL_SUPPORT.next: Scout drilling (60-100 m) across the chargeability anomaly.

POSITIVE_GEOCHEMICAL_SUPPORT.next: Ground geophysics (IP / resistivity) and trenching, then scout drilling.

NO_SUBSURFACE_EVIDENCE.next: Geological mapping and soil / stream-sediment geochemistry over the footprint.

priority_gates._note: Hard gates applied BEFORE scoring for contingency selection (project policy).
